_help: One entry per release, newest first. 'version' must match package.json. Write for the people who use the app: plain words, what they will notice. The release workflow refuses to build a tag that has no entry here. Groups: new, improved, fixed (any of them may be empty).

releases.title: More languages, System Update and Mobile Control Center
new: More languages: Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu and Chhattisgarhi are now available in Settings, Language, alongside Hindi.
System Update screen under Utility: see the installed version and what is available.
Mobile Control Center for administrators: review member app activation requests, member access and phone quality in one place.
improved: Error messages now say in plain words what went wrong and what to do next, instead of showing technical text.
The screens you open most were refreshed for consistency.

releases.title: Guided start and Hindi
new: A welcome walkthrough for new users: terms and conditions, your profile, an optional password change, a hand-drawn tour of the screen and slides on how loans, recoveries and day-end work.
A getting-started checklist at the bottom of the dashboard that tracks your first steps.
Hindi language support: choose your language in Settings. The Settings and Change Password screens are translated so far.
Help now has Replay Tour, How It Works and Getting Started, so you can bring any guide back at any time.
Administrators choose in Settings, Welcome Tour, whether the tour shows on the first login or on every login, and can see who has accepted the terms.
improved: The tour follows your role: you only see the menus and slides you can use.
Keyboard navigation for the tour, and a Calm mode in Settings that turns off the motion.
